theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_fr_cone_scaling
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → μ ((fun x => lam • x) '' W) = ENNReal.ofReal lam * μ W) → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen K → (∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∀ x ∈ K, c • x ∈ K) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μ (K ∩ ball 0 r) = ENNReal.ofReal r * μ (K ∩ ball 0 1)
